name: 笑红尘Ⅱ
english_name: Xiao Hong Chen II (Laughing at the Red Dust II)
english_description: Developed by Topkan Information Group (topkan.com), Xiao Hong Chen II shares its map — sects and cities including Huashan, Wudang, Emei, the Beggars' Sect, the Ming Cult, Dali, and Jingzhou — and its "Peak of the World" cliff-jump scene (down to the exact wizard-immunity check) almost verbatim with this collection's tybxjh (the lineage's root) and wlhd, a relationship this pass also traced to several other archives sharing the same "Tianya" master/securityd/logind core — zxty, ffxymud, jhfy2, xysylmhb, and xyzxiiylzymh — that AGENTS.md had not previously recorded. Registration here uses a single password rather than tybxjh's dual-password scheme. WASM testing initially judged the archive fully working, but deep functional testing corrected that assessment and found two severe, previously-undocumented bugs of its own: a missing log directory silently truncated every single registration right after gender selection (100% reproducible, earlier misdiagnosed as a client-side timing race), and a redundant self-inherited replace_program() call crashed the post command on all roughly 90 of the game's bulletin boards. Both are fixed; see NOTES.md.
